project_type: Full-stack marketing application with a Vue 3/Vite/TypeScript frontend and a Fastify/TypeScript/Prisma/PostgreSQL backend
language: TypeScript, Vue single-file components, Prisma schema, and PostgreSQL SQL migrations
build_system: Two npm projects under backend/ and frontend/; Node.js 22.11.0 is pinned by backend/.nvmrc
test_framework: Vitest. Backend tests use Fastify injection and optional real PostgreSQL integration through TEST_DATABASE_URL. Frontend tests use Vitest, jsdom, and @vue/test-utils.
build_command: source $HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.11.0 && (cd backend && npm run build) && (cd frontend && npm run build)
test_command: source $HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.11.0 && (cd backend && npm run test:unit && npm run test:performance) && (cd frontend && npm run test)
verification_instructions: Use Node 22.11.0. Generate and validate Prisma with cd backend && npm run db:generate && npx prisma validate. Apply committed migrations only to the configured disposable TEST_DATABASE_URL before database-backed tests. Run backend unit tests, backend performance integration tests, and backend build. Run frontend unit tests and frontend build. Inspect the Add Weekly Metrics modal to confirm Total Engagement is editable, LinkedIn Native Engagement Rate (%) is disabled, the rate updates from Total Engagement / Impressions * 100, and zero impressions has no finite rate.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Prisma Client is generated with backend/npm run db:generate into ignored dependencies. Frontend and backend dist outputs are generated by npm run build and are not source edits. No checked-in snapshots were found.
setup_instructions: Run source $HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.11.0. In backend run npm install and npm run db:generate. In frontend run npm ci. DATABASE_URL and TEST_DATABASE_URL are configured and distinct. Do not print either value. Do not reset any database.
environment_constraints: The shell defaults to Node 20.20.2, which does not satisfy backend/package.json; Node 22.11.0 is installed through nvm and must be selected. The Docker CLI could not be inspected in the sandbox, but both database URLs are configured. The migration backend/prisma/migrations/20261031100000_brand_check_failure_overrides/ is untracked and was already deployed to the local database. Preserve all pre-existing uncommitted edits. Only deploy new migration verification to TEST_DATABASE_URL unless explicitly authorized otherwise.
contribution_requirements: backend/AGENTS.md requires the modular monolith, thin routes, domain invariants outside routes, centralized Prisma access, migration-first database changes, focused tests, and alignment with docs/BACKEND_ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/DATABASE_SCHEMA.md, and docs/API_CONTRACT.md. frontend/AGENTS.md requires Vue Composition API with script setup, reuse of BaseInput/BaseModal and existing components, typed domain models, responsive behavior, no unnecessary dependencies, and npm run build validation.
key_patterns: LinkedInMetricsView.vue owns a reactive modal form and uses BaseInput hints/errors. The performance Pinia store uploads optional evidence, sends a transport payload, normalizes BackendWeeklyMetric, and tracks ETags. Backend routes whitelist and parse exact request keys, while metrics.ts validates domain inputs, writes within Prisma transactions, maps API resources, and preserves correction ETags. reporting.ts currently derives engagements from likes + comments + saves and reads stored nativeEngagementRate. The new model should persist an independent nullable BigInt engagements column for provider compatibility, require it for manual LinkedIn writes, calculate native rate as engagements / impressions * 100 with null for zero impressions, and keep the existing native_engagement_rate column only as a non-destructive compatibility field while server code owns the calculation. Existing LinkedIn rows can be backfilled from the prior likes + comments + saves behavior. UI strings also have Indonesian entries in frontend/src/i18n/dictionary.ts.
directory_structure: frontend/src/views contains route screens, frontend/src/stores Pinia API state, frontend/src/api typed HTTP adapters, frontend/src/types domain and backend DTO types, frontend/src/components/ui reusable controls, and frontend/src/**/*.spec.ts jsdom tests. backend/src/modules/performance contains route parsing, metric commands, integrations, evaluation, and reporting. backend/tests contains integration suites. backend/prisma contains schema.prisma and ordered SQL migrations. docs contains canonical architecture, database, API, phase, evaluation, and design records.
